description: This file defines classes and utilities for data pipeline abstractions in PyTorch, including iterable and map-style data pipes, serialization wrappers, and related methods.

classes.name: DataChunk
classes.description: A list subclass representing a chunk of data items with additional string representation and raw iterator methods.

classes.name: IterDataPipe
classes.description: An abstract base class for iterable data pipes, supporting iteration, attribute access, registration of functions, and serialization hooks.

classes.name: DFIterDataPipe
classes.description: A subclass of IterDataPipe indicating DataFrame-specific behavior.

classes.name: MapDataPipe
classes.description: A dataset class representing map-style data pipes with support for attribute access, registration, and serialization.

classes.name: _DataPipeSerializationWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for serializing data pipes using pickle or dill.

classes.name: _IterDataPipeSerializationWrapper
classes.description: A serialization wrapper for IterDataPipe instances, supporting iteration and next operations.

classes.name: _MapDataPipeSerializationWrapper
classes.description: A serialization wrapper for MapDataPipe instances, supporting item access.

methods.name: as_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DataChunk items with optional indentation.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the DataChunk or DataPipe.

methods.name: raw_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the raw items in DataChunk.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves registered functions as methods.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a new function for the DataPipe class.

methods.name: register_datapipe_as_function
methods.description: Registers a class method as a functional API for the DataPipe.

methods.name: __getstate__
methods.description: Serializes the DataPipe, optionally using dill if available.

methods.name: __reduce_ex__
methods.description: Supports custom pickling behavior with hooks.

methods.name: set_getstate_hook
methods.description: Sets a custom hook for getstate serialization.

methods.name: set_reduce_ex_hook
methods.description: Sets a custom hook for reduce_ex serialization.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DataPipe.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DataPipe.

methods.name: __dir__
methods.description: Provides auto-completion support with registered functions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the DataPipe to its initial state; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: _is_dfpipe
methods.description: Indicates if the DataPipe is a DataFrame-specific pipe.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Accesses items by index in MapDataPipe wrappers.
